# HAL149

> HAL149 is the personal publishing platform of Luis, a strategist and builder working at the intersection of AI, business architecture and philosophy. It publishes essays, project write-ups and field notes on how organizations should be redesigned around autonomous, AI-native capabilities, backed by long-horizon thinking. English at the root, Spanish under /es/.

## Topic hubs
- [Agentic Systems](https://hal149.com/topics/agentic-systems): software that pursues goals by planning, using tools and acting within permissions.
- [AI-Native Business Architecture](https://hal149.com/topics/ai-native-business-architecture): designing structure, processes and governance around autonomous capabilities.
- [Philosophy of Technology](https://hal149.com/topics/philosophy-of-technology): purpose, judgment, responsibility and delegation.
- [The Future of Work & Organizations](https://hal149.com/topics/future-of-work-and-organizations): roles, hybrid teams and management with AI agents.
